windows.notes: Round 5 (scripts/looks_ref_a/btn5.py, btn4.py; scale 1.0, max per-channel error outside the caption, tolerance 2). button_states.png has a cell for all 31 live button grabs (states/button-*: 29 pressed or focused, the disabled Edit Rule, 75x23, 85x25 and 125x25 buttons) and for the 6 hover grabs (states/hover-button-options-*), each with 5 px of its own dialog around it and that dialog's face behind. Crisp-ring dialogs (Search, Sort, Missing Set Cards, Filter, Advanced Filter, Conditional Formatting, Statistics): rest, default, pressed (default and plain), focused (default and plain, 75x23 and 85x25) all within 1 level (0 px over 2): Search rest 0, pressed OK and Cancel 1, Sort OK and Clear 1, Filter OK, Clear and All 1, focused Invert 1 (was 3 and 6 levels over 127 px: the outer ring rows and corner cells now carry their share over the dialog face, solved from the same ring on the #F0F0F0 and #F9F9F9 faces), Missing OK 1, Advanced OK and Open 1, Conditional Formatting OK 1 and focused OK 0, Statistics Close 1; the button.png, button_kinds.png and button_shift.png cells 0 to 1 outside the picture. The four DPI-scaled forms (Options, About, Deck Properties, Deck Legality) draw every button as the crisp one moved by a sub-pixel offset that grows with its position (bilinear: the horizontal profile fits to 0.2 level), so the ring, the focus rectangle and the caption blur: modelled by ButtonOptions.shift_x and shift_y (fitted per capture, fitshift.py) and a pixel mixer in winbutton.ring_paint_shifted. Max error now: About OK pressed 37, Options OK, Cancel and Apply pressed 39, focused Cancel and Apply 43, Change pressed 21 and focused 24, Set 35, Reset 37, Validate 35, Deck Properties OK 39, Deck Legality Close 39, Standard 11, Modern focused 11, hover OK, Cancel and Apply 48, Change 35, Set 45, Reset 45 (64 to 167 before the shift). Hover is now measured (the scaled forms only): face #E0EEF9 inside the accent ring, applied in style.windows_resolve and the ring kind. Also: the ring tile renders whole at 75x32 and 125x40 (cells with no capture), 1.5x draws the ring and dots on whole device pixels (winpx.fill, merged from master), the default button gives up its accent to a focused button (button_shift).

windows.notes: Round 5 (scripts/looks_ref_a/lbl4.py; ink box = the pixels more than 150 levels from the background, scale 1.0). label.png has 11 cells: the ten captured labels (Row Color, Card, MTG Studio 13 bold, path, gray text, MTG Studio 21 bold, version, the two hot-links, the wrapped text) and the pressed link (identical to its rest crop). v3 draws with GDI, whose glyph advances are the fonts' hdmx widths, so a label is now set glyph by glyph on those (winhint.advance, control.windows_hinted_row): ink boxes agree with the captures within 1 px in x and y on all 11 cells (x min and max, ours against capture: Row Color 2-52 vs 2-53, Card 1-26 vs 2-26, MTG Studio 2-71 vs 3-72, path 2-214 vs 3-214, gray 2-160 vs 2-160, 21 px title 41-159 vs 42-160, version 51-150 vs 51-150, hot-links 50-154 vs 50-154 and 57-144 vs 57-144, wrapped 2-230 vs 2-230); before they were up to 4 px off (the path was 195 against 214 px wide). Centred labels sit on whole pixels by floor((box - text) / 2); the sheet puts every box on whole pixels so a half pixel offset no longer blurs the text and the underline.
